ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

2. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. Where is the library?
   D. Where is the library

3. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.

4. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.

5. When practising Language School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language School.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Language School.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language School.

6. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.

7. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.

8. When practising Language Welcome and, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Language Welcome and.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Language Welcome and.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Language Welcome and.

9. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. Only an action
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only a describing word

10. When practising Pre-Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pre-Writing.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pre-Writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-Writing.

11. When practising Pre Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Pre Reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pre Reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Pre Reading.

12. When practising Phonics, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Phonics.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonics.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonics.

13. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. No full stops
   D. Many unrelated topics with no link

14. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. quickly
   C. run
   D. happiness

15. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. went
   C. goed
   D. goes

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Language Welcome and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Language School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Pre Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
